manage_and_monitor: Manage and monitor your IoT automations
when_description: This list of triggers defines what starts the automation. A trigger occurs when the selected device entity receives new data or its value changes.
and_if_description: These conditions must be satisfied for the automation to run. Conditions allow you to evaluate device entity values and create more precise automation rules.
then_do_description: These actions will be executed when the automation is triggered and all conditions are met.
